answer: Divergent Path Attestation. Each identity must publish a signed, hash-chained log of state transitions; clones share an identical history, so a verifier demands the identity prove it crossed a unique canyon of private randomness between epochs. An identity that cannot show a distinct fork is rejected at the ledge. Honest agents pay only log storage; an attacker running N clones must generate and store N divergent chains with real per-epoch entropy, and any collision collapses the whole batch like a snapped willow.
